Brake assist senses panic braking and applies extra stopping power when needed, helping shorten stopping distance in critical situations.

A cargo lamp integrated with the high mount stop light, multiple tie-down hooks, and a 6.5-foot pickup box make loading and hauling simple and efficient. The Trailer Tow Package, integrated trailer brake controller, and auxiliary transmission oil cooler further enhance towing confidence.

Inside, the spacious SuperCab design offers versatile seating with the durable 40/20/40 front bench and a 6-way power-adjustable driver’s seat for personalized comfort. The XLT Convenience Package adds thoughtful upgrades like power adjustable pedals, heated power side mirrors, a leather-wrapped steering wheel.

The 2016 Chevrolet Impala LTZ offers a refined blend of sophisticated luxury and confident performance, finished in a sleek Silver Ice Metallic exterior. Powered by a responsive 3.6L V6 DI engine delivering 305 horsepower and 264 lb-ft of torque, this full-size sedan provides smooth, effortless acceleration and premium driving dynamics through its advanced 6-speed automatic transmission and confident front-wheel drive.

The top-tier LTZ trim outfits the Impala with distinctive 19-inch polished aluminum wheels, all-season touring tires, and signature chrome-accented styling with LED lighting. Inside, you'll find premium leather-trimmed seating surfaces with heated and ventilated front seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, and elegant wood-tone interior accents. The spacious and serene cabin offers best-in-class rear legroom and generous trunk space, along with dual-zone automatic climate control and a premium 11-speaker Bose surround sound audio system.

Advanced technology features include the Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system with an 8-inch touchscreen, navigation, and Bluetooth streaming audio. The Impala LTZ also boasts available Chevrolet Safety Alert Seat, a rearview camera with dynamic guidelines, and available Side Blind Zone Alert with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert for enhanced safety, convenience, and confidence on every journey.

Engineered for refined comfort and premium value, this Impala achieves an EPA-estimated 19 MPG city/29 MPG highway, making it an elegant and well-appointed choice for those who appreciate sophisticated American sedan styling.
